title: Rent Due Day, Proration Basis and Rounding — Home-Site Lease Billing Conventions
content:
**Billing conventions of the Home-Site Lease rent ledger**

The site rent for each month falls due on a fixed calendar day of that month; a partial month of site rent is prorated on a fixed basis; and every computed charge, credit and fee is rounded the same way.

| Lot class | Rent due day | Proration of a partial month | Rounding of every computed amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 1st of the month | actual days in the month | half up to the cent |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 1st of the month | actual days in the month | half up to the cent |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 1st of the month | actual days in the month | half up to the cent |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 1st of the month | actual days in the month | half up to the cent |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 1st of the month | actual days in the month | half up to the cent |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 1st of the month | actual days in the month | half up to the cent |

**Actual days in the month.** A partial month is the monthly rent divided by the number of calendar days in that calendar month, multiplied by the days occupied.

**Half up to the cent.** An amount is rounded to two decimal places, a remainder of exactly half a cent being rounded up.

### Worked figures (hypothetical rent)

| Monthly rent | Month | Days in month | Days occupied | Prorated rent before rounding | Rounded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 700.00 | a 30-day month | 30 | 12 | 280.000 | 280.00 |
| 700.00 | a 31-day month | 31 | 12 | 270.967… | 270.97 |
| 700.00 | a 28-day month | 28 | 12 | 300.000 | 300.00 |
| 625.00 | a 31-day month | 31 | 17 | 342.741… | 342.74 |

The same twelve days of occupancy cost a different amount in months of different length, because the divisor is the actual number of days in that month.
